title: Just Listed! Stunning 3-Bedroom Home in Sunterra, Katy TX | Modern Upgrades & Resort-Style Living
description:
🏡 Welcome to Your Dream Home in Sunterra – Katy, TX!
This beautifully designed single-story home is located in the highly desirable Sunterra master-planned community and features the elegant Chrysanthemum floor plan. With nearly 1,900 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space, this home offers comfort, style, and resort-style community living.

✨ Home Features:
✅ 3 Spacious Bedrooms & 2 Full Bathrooms
✅ Flex Space – Perfect for Home Office or Playroom
✅ Gourmet Kitchen w/ Quartz Countertops, Island & Stainless Steel Appliances
✅ Open-Concept Living, Dining & Kitchen
✅ Private Primary Suite w/ En-Suite Bath & Walk-In Closet
✅ Extended Covered Patio & Private Backyard
✅ Full Sprinkler System, Gutters & Modern Finishes Throughout

🌟 Community Amenities Include:
🏖️ Lazy River & Resort-Style Pool
🏡 Clubhouse & Parks
🌳 Walking Trails & Family-Friendly Events
📍 Close to top-rated schools, shopping, dining & major highways
